user.title: Mercedes EV Logbook web app
user.description: Serves the logbook as a phone web app at your Home Assistant address followed by {path}, for example https://example.ui.nabu.casa{path}. Open it in Safari on an iPhone (or Chrome on Android), sign in with your Home Assistant account and add it to the home screen. Editing trips needs a Home Assistant administrator.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The web app is already set up.
